verdict.rationale: Stripe's documented webhook system, which Terminal payments run on alongside online payments, lets you register an HTTPS endpoint, and Stripe then pushes real-time event data to it. That is genuine outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: evidence naming Terminal-specific event types (e.g., reader or action events), details on event selection/filtering, retries or signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
You can create an HTTPS webhook endpoint to receive events.
you can accept in-person payments and manage them alongside your online payments in Stripe
